stem: A reusable pruning tool was used on a plant showing unusual vascular discoloration. What should happen before the tool is used on another plant?
choices: Wipe visible sap away and continue
Use the approved cleaning and disinfection procedure before reuse or remove the tool from service if required
Use it only on plants of the same cultivar
rationale: Visible cleanliness does not establish that a tool is safe to move between plants. Approved sanitation procedures control cross-contamination risk.
